title: PM to launch ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan’ on 2nd August
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Launch to mark Beginning of 100-Week Nationwide Jan Bhagidari Campaign against Substance Abuse

Adding to this, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will launch the ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan' on 2nd August 2026 at 11 AM through video conferencing. The initiative aims to inspire youth to stay away from substance abuse and encourage them to become ambassadors of positive social change in their communities

Meanwhile, The launch will mark the beginning of a 100-week nationwide Jan Bhagidari campaign against substance abuse. Under this campaign, weekly activities will be organised every Sunday across the country to promote awareness and encourage public participation in building a drug-free society. The activities will include sports events, walkathons, meditation sessions, cultural programmes, awareness campaigns, nukkad nataks, discussion forums, art competitions and community engagement programmes.

Notably, The initiative seeks to further strengthen community participation by bringing together educational institutions, youth organisations, civil society groups, industry bodies and spiritual organisations on a common platform to create a collective movement against substance abuse.

As per the latest buzz, The programme will witness participation from youth across the country from over 10,000 locations. MY Bharat Volunteers, MY Bharat National Service Scheme volunteers, youth clubs, schools, colleges, universities, NGOs, youth wings of industry associations and more than 125 partner spiritual organisations will participate in the programme virtually.

title: Ramayana actor Chetan Hansraj slams 'keyboard superstars' for backlash to casting and VFX: 'Critics are in dreamland’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ever since the trailer of Ramayana was rolled out on Thursday, there has been considerable discussion around the movie's casting and VFX. While a section of social media has criticised both aspects, star Chetan Hansraj, who plays the demon Mali in the Nitesh Tiwari movie, has defended the movie and its team.

Adding to this, Chetan Hansraj defends casting of Ramayana amid criticism. Chetan Hansraj defends Ramayana In an interview with Variety India, the star opened up that everyone on the sets of Ramayana was soft-spoken and lauded Yash for being gentle with the cast and crew. Chetan added that despite having worked in the industry for 47 years, the 20 days he spent shooting for Ramayana were the best 20 days of his entire career.

Meanwhile, Several social media users have criticised Ranbir Kapoor 's casting as Lord Rama, calling him a misfit. Reacting to the debate around the casting in Ramayana, Chetan shared, "I think the casting is fabulous. Ranbir as Ram is fabulous. I really like the manner in which he has carried off his look. Sai Pallavi is also very nice. Everyone has their opinion, but Namit Malhotra, Nitesh Tiwari and the team have done a lot of research for the looks and characters, and finalised the cast after a lot of deliberation.”

Notably, Since the trailer was rolled out, the movie's VFX has also been dissected extensively online. Chetan described the critics as "keyboard VFX superstars" and shared, "They are in dreamland. When you see Ramayana on the big screen, you will understand the scale. It is unfathomable. All these critics don't understand the scale."

As per the latest buzz, The trailer opens with Yash as Ravana conquering Lanka, before introducing Ranbir Kapoor as Prince Ram, who fights demons alongside Lakshman (Ravi Dubey). After a promise made to Kaikeyi (Lara Dutta), Ram is sent into 14 years of vanvaas, with Sita (Sai Pallavi) choosing to accompany him. The trailer also teases the larger conflict between Ram and Ravana through grand action sequences and VFX, while Lord Hanuman remains absent.

In further updates, Helmed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana also stars Sunny Deol, Ravi Dubey, Arun Govil, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh and Vivek Oberoi in key roles. The movie will rollout in two parts, with the first part hitting the screens on Diwali 2026.

title: I'm here to find my own audience and create my own path: 'Musafir Cafe' actor Mahima Makwana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Mahima Makwana believes every star eventually has to find their own audience and her latest Netflix series "Musafir Cafe" is another step in a career that she is determined to shape on her own terms.

Adding to this, I'm here to find my own audience and create my own path: 'Musafir Cafe' star Mahima Makwana The unpredictability of showbiz world has taught her patience and perseverance, shared the star, who started out as a child star on daily soaps "Miley Jab Hum Tum" and
Meanwhile, "Balika Vadhu" before making the transition to films with Salman Khan's "Antim: The Final Truth" and later to OTT projects such as "Tumse Na Hoo Payega" and "Showtime".

Notably, "I feel that if I can do it, everybody can do it. It's important to dream, it's all about believing in yourself. I'll always be grateful to the people who saw that potential in me. At the same time, our industry demands patience and perseverance. It's not an easy industry and there is hardly anything in your control. All you can control are the choices you make from the offers you're given.

As per the latest buzz, "You learn, you unlearn, you realise and you create your own niche. I'm here to find my own audience, to create my own path, and that's how I've been navigating my journey," she added," Makwana told PTI in an interview.

In further updates, Makwana credits "Antim", which featured her alongside Salman and Ayush Sharma, as a turning point in her career. The 2021 movie, directed by Mahesh Manjrekar, marked her Hindi movie debut.

On top of that, "I'll always be grateful for the opportunity that Salman sir and Mahesh Manjrekar sir gave me because I always wanted to see myself on the big screen. And that project changed everything for me, it made me believe in myself.

"When people like them see potential in you, it kind of makes you believe in yourself. 'Antim' opened so many doors for me... 'Showtime' and 'Tumse Na Hoo Payega', happened and every part, every opportunity has given me something or the other in terms of critical acclaim, or people that I've worked with," she shared.

title: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sharvari give sanskari vibes in first pics from sets of Sooraj Barjatya's Ye Prem Mol Liya. See pics
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It's a return to old-school for Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari as they gear up for the rollout of Sooraj Barjatya 's romantic drama, Ye Prem Mol Liya. On Saturday, Ayushmann shared a few stills from the set, informing that the movie had wrapped its shoot. Hours later, some unseen behind-the-scenes shots were leaked online, giving a more detailed view of the world created by the veteran filmmaker in this new-age love story.

Adding to this, Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari shoot Ye Prem Mol Liya. First pics show the world of Ye Prem Mol Liya On Saturday, Ayushmann shared snaps with director Sooraj Barjatya and co-star Sharvari from the sets of their movie. While sharing the photos, Ayushmann wrote, “Wrapped the shoot of Yeh Prem Mol Liya in the most auspicious way at Banganga. With our hearts full of love and gratitude, thank you Sooraj sir, Rajshri Productions, Mahaveer Jain and the entire team for making this journey so special. We can't wait to bring this Sooraj Barjatya movie to you and your family only in cinemas on 27th November.”

Meanwhile, The pictures show him and Sharvari walking down the steps of a railway bridge hand in hand. Another picture has them next to the filmmaker with the clapper, while yet another shows them with the cast and crew after the wrap.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ayushmann Khurrana (@ayushmannk)

As per the latest buzz, Unseen pictures of the two actors were then shared on social media, showing them in ethnic wear, standing on a ghat in what looked like a puja scene. Followers reacted positively to the pictures, saying the setting looked different from the ‘sanitised’ love stories Bollywood has been showcasing of late.
In further updates, On Friday, Anupam Kher shared his experience working on a movie with Sooraj Barjatya, calling it ‘another beautiful chapter in his extraordinary journey’ in cinema.

On top of that, "AND IT IS A WRAP.... Last night, we completed the picture wrap of Sooraj Barjatya's #YehPremMolLiya. I've known Sooraj from the time he was an assistant on my very first movie, Saaransh. Since then, we have shared the journey of more than eight films together. Watching him evolve into one of the greatest storytellers of our times has been a privilege," the veteran star wrote on Instagram.

Backed by Rajshri Productions in association with Mahaveer Jain Films, the movie stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in lead roles. The movie was revealed in April this year. The movie also reunites Barjatya with composer Himesh Reshammiya after their previous collaboration on Prem Ratan Dhan Payo. The movie releases in theatres on November 27.

title: Randeep Hooda reaches Assam to take part in flood relief efforts, serves food to displaced at langar: 'It is our duty'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Randeep Hooda is in Assam, taking part in a flood relief distribution programme organised by an NGO in Sivasagar. On Saturday, the star distributed rations and other essential supplies to the flood-affected population of Sivasagar in association with Global Sikhs. The floods in Assam have so far claimed 82 lives and displaced millions.

Adding to this, Randeep Hooda during flood relief drive in Assam's Sivasagar. Randeep Hooda participates in flood relief drive in Assam On Saturday, Randeep distributed essential items to displaced people at the railway station in Sivasagar. Later, the star also visited the Gurudwara Sahib in Sivasagar and offered his prayers for the well-being of people in flood-affected Assam.

Meanwhile, While serving food through langar, Randeep Hooda told media present there, “This is the Sivasagar railway station, and many affected families have come here from the surrounding areas. Sowe make the food, bring it to them, and have been doing this every day for the last seven days. Humanity is above everything else. I have been working with the same team, Global Sikhs, for many years, and the groundwork they lay is amazing. I would urge everybody to contribute in whichever way they can to help people, not just here, but wherever there is a problem. As human beings, it is our duty to help our fellow human beings. That is why we are here.”

Notably, Randeep, who of late won the National Movie Award for his direction of Savarakar, shared that he and the team have already arranged many basic amenities for those affected by the flood. “The team has already done a lot of research on what they need, mostly people need immediate relief in everyday amenities, food and things like a place to sleep, a mattress, a torpiline. So, we are making kits, and we'll be distributing them to whoever needs them, and our team is also out there looking for people who have not received help yet, so we are trying to do that as well,” the star added.

As per the latest buzz, According to the reports of the Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA), 82 people have lost their lives in floods in the state so far. Earlier on Friday, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma expressed gratitude to industrialist Gautam Adani for contributing ₹ 11 crore rupees to the Chief Minister's Relief Fund to support relief and rehabilitation efforts for people affected by floods in the state.

He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). title: Seema Sajdeh says she and Sohail Khan are 'better friends than couple' after Alliance reunion: ‘Done with toxic phase’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Alliance brought together Bollywood star Sohail Khan and his ex-wife Seema Sajdeh on screen once again. While many on the internet expected the former couple to have confrontations on the reality show, they ended up surprising viewers with their camaraderie and mutual respect. Throughout the season, Seema emerged as one of Sohail's biggest support systems before her recent eviction.

Adding to this, Sohail Khan got emotional after Seema Sajdeh's eviction from Alliance. 'We're better friends than we ever were as a couple' In a recent interaction, Seema spoke about supporting Sohail on the show and admitted that they have become better friends after their divorce. She told The Times of India, “At the end of the day, we are parents to two beautiful boys. We've been divorced for four years now. We've gone through our motions and we're a great team when it comes to the boys. We're better friends than we ever were as a couple.”

Meanwhile, During the show, Sohail had shared how Seema's stint inside the Alliance house helped the two reconnect. Speaking about how their equation has evolved after living together in the house, Seema shared, “Sohail is an emotional person. I think being in captivity made him even more emotional. But no. Like I shared, we're a unit when it comes to our children and we're co-parenting them beautifully. We're great friends today. Every divorce has its stages of anger and lashing out. We've been through all of that, the toxic phase and the bad phase. It's all done and dusted now because we both have to think about our two children, who never asked for any of this. I think we are better allies as friends than we ever were as a couple.”

Notably, Seema also reflected on her experience of being on the show and admitted that she was surprised by how competitive the contestants could get. She shared that a major part of the game isn't just about winning tasks, but also about building genuine connections and forming emotional alliances with fellow contestants.

title: Yami Gautam reveals she was ready to quit Bollywood before Uri's success, favouritism left her ‘hurt’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Yami Gautam of late admitted that she almost quit the Hindi movie industry just before starring in Vicky Kaushal -led Uri : The Surgical Strike. In a recent interaction, the star opened up that she did not receive meaningful opportunities for several years after making her debut with Vicky Donor in 2012. Disheartened by the lack of substantial roles, Yami shared she had decided to quit acting and move back to her home in Himachal Pradesh.

Adding to this, Star Yami Gautam on almost quitting acting. 'Had made peace with leaving the industry' In a recent interaction, Yami shared that despite the success of her debut movie, many considered her launch in the industry "unconventional" because she "hadn't been introduced as the typical heroine." She admitted that this perception affected her career. After years of waiting for a meaningful opportunity, Yami had almost given up on acting when she landed Uri: The Surgical Strike in 2019, a movie that went on to change the trajectory of her career.

Meanwhile, In conversation with Filmfare, she shared, “Just before Uri and Bala, I had made peace with leaving the industry altogether. I thought I'd return to Himachal. We have farmland there. I imagined beginning a completely different life. My parents were incredibly supportive. They simply shared, 'Come home.' And strangely, the moment I stopped clinging to the industry out of fear, everything changed. Uri happened. Bala happened. Life changed almost overnight.”

Notably, During the interaction, Yami also opened up about the challenges she faced as an outsider in the movie industry, where star kids often receive multiple opportunities and room to grow as actors despite setbacks, while outsiders have to struggle even for a single chance.

As per the latest buzz, She shared, “The difficult part wasn't being an outsider. It was constantly having to prove yourself. Sometimes you'd feel you were ready for a particular opportunity, yet someone else would receive repeated chances simply because they already belonged to the ecosystem. You'd think, If I were given that many opportunities, wouldn't I also continue growing as an star? That was the real frustration. But I genuinely believe things have changed. Today, audiences don't care where you come from. They care whether you're a good star. Whether your films are worth watching. Whether they trust your choices. That gives me tremendous hope for the next generation.”

In further updates, Yami also admitted that she was "hurt" by the favouritism she witnessed in the industry. She recalled how conversations around potential films would suddenly stop without any explanation, and opportunities she had hoped for would quietly slip away.

title: Crim Inclusive Playground facilitates friendship amongst youth of all abilities
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Two summers ago, intervention specialist Rachel Shell learned that she would be working with two students who are wheelchair-users. As part of her preparation, she evaluated Crim Elementary School’s playground and discovered there was not much opportunity for them to play freely with other students. If the children wanted to use any equipment, they needed full physical assistance from adults.

Adding to this, Understanding the importance of play, Shell set out to create a playground that was inclusive for children of all abilities. She began looking for equipment, getting quotes, planning, fundraising, and applying for grants to make her vision a reality.
Meanwhile, “All the things I had never done before,” Shell shared. “It was a real ‘learn-by-doing’ experience.”
Notably, “Through sheer determination, a lot of grit, and some rose-colored glasses, we were able to raise the funds,” she shared.

As per the latest buzz, The inclusive playground features new equipment and a poured rubber path. Most playgrounds, including Crim Elementary’s, have mulch, which is difficult to wheel a chair through. The poured rubber path aims to circumvent this issue and has equipment directly on it.

In further updates, “It’s really great to see the community investing in their public schools,” Shell shared. “I could … [tell] you about the students it’s going to benefit – the two wheelchair users, any students that have some kind of physical disability that makes it difficult to access the equipment – but really the whole point of adding inclusive equipment is that anybody can use it. It’s not just for kids who use wheelchairs.”
On top of that, “It’s so they can build these relationships and build friendships without the barrier of needing adults to facilitate that,” Shell continued.

Superintendent Ted Haselman thanked Shell for her efforts in spearheading the construction of the inclusive playground. He also noted that the playground will be used by many students of all abilities for years to come.

title: Spider-Man and the Punisher’s Complicated History in the Comics, Explained
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

While Spider-Man has plenty of amazing friends throughout the Marvel Universe, one of his most complicated relationships is with the Punisher , if one can truly call them friends at all. While the two Super Heroes maintain a certain respect for each other, Frank Castle’s open willingness to use lethal force to punish the wicked puts an understandable strain on their dynamic. At the same time, when the two vigilantes share a common goal, they temporarily set aside their differences to work together towards the greater good – even if they define that differently.

Adding to this, Simply put, Spider-Man and the Punisher’s complex dynamic can be better described as “frenemies.” That distinction comes with plenty of comic book history to draw from, so let’s recount the most noteworthy instances that Spider-Man and the Punisher have crossed paths. These stories showcase how Spidey and the Punisher’s relationship evolved over the years, from their hostile first encounter to the tenuous understanding the two characters now have of each other.

Meanwhile, The Punisher made his Marvel Comics debut as an antagonistic figure pitted against Spider-Man in AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #129 by Gerry Conway and Ross Andru . Blaming Spider-Man for the death of Gwen Stacy , the cloning obsessed villain the Jackal convinced the Punisher that the friendly neighborhood webslinger was a murderer. This led Castle to hunt Spidey across the rooftops of Manhattan, quickly proving just how lethal his aim was as he cornered the Wall-Crawler.

Notably, Left with no other choice, Spider-Man overpowered the Punisher long enough to get the gun-toting vigilante to listen to reason. After Spider-Man proved that the Jackal was a villain, the Punisher finally dropped his hunt. But even after getting off on the wrong foot, Spider-Man and the Punisher would soon cross paths again and would find themselves on the same side.

As per the latest buzz, The second time that Spider-Man and the Punisher met, the two costumed heroes were temporarily at odds with each other after yet another misunderstanding. AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #135 opened with Spidey sparring with the spider-themed villain, Tarantula , for taking a local cruise ship captive. When the Punisher investigated the incident, he mistakenly believed Spider-Man to be in on the plot, leading the two to come to blows once more.

In further updates, Just as with their first skirmish, the Punisher quickly realized the error of his ways and recognized that Spider-Man wasn’t his enemy. Striking up a tenuous alliance, the two figures worked together to defeat Tarantula, and after tracking the villain down, Castle surprisingly agreed not to use lethal force. The instance marked the first time Spidey and the Punisher actively worked together against a common threat, but it certainly wouldn’t be the last time they joined forces.

On top of that, After a sniper terrorized Coney Island, Spider-Man teamed up with Nightcrawler to uncover the culprit in AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #161 by Len Wein and Andru . The investigation resulted in the two heroes encountering the Punisher, who was separately looking into the incident and initially felt wary of the duo. The three reluctantly worked together, eventually identifying Jigsaw as the crazed gunman, leading to a big showdown in AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #162 , which marked the villain’s debut appearance.

While tension filled the air, Spider-Man and the Punisher proved to be an even more effective team, with the added benefit of Nightcrawler joining the partnership. The introduction of Jigsaw also gave the Punisher the worst nemesis he has ever known, and their subsequent feud would become a consequential chapter in their shared history in the Marvel Universe. By expanding the Punisher's role and giving him a memorable recurring foe, AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #162 proved to be yet another pivotal issue for Frank Castle.

title: The Best ‘Breaking Bad’ Character Proved He Was Better Than Walter White
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Namely, Mike ( Jonathan Banks ), Gus ( Giancarlo Esposito ), and the sleazy criminal lawyer Saul Goodman ( Bob Odenkirk ), who made his debut appearance in an episode titled "Better Call Saul" written by Peter Gould . Cut to six years later, Better Call Saul hit our screens as the prequel spin-off story of Jimmy McGill, a down-on-his-luck lawyer looking to make a name for himself but fighting the urge to use his talents as a con-man.

Adding to this, Although the writers toyed with the idea of Better Call Saul being a half-hour sitcom in which Saul represents various interesting characters, the show itself ended up becoming a similar format to its predecessor. Naturally, the story of how the downtrodden Jimmy McGill became the Saul Goodman we know from Breaking Bad (something that took a full four seasons to officially happen) mirrors the story of Walter White's transition into Heisenberg.

Meanwhile, For this reason among others, comparisons between the two shows were inevitable, with Better Call Saul excellently surviving the enormous pressure, delivering an arguably superior product to the original. How then was Better Call Saul able to give Jimmy a finale that redeemed his character despite the six seasons working to demoralize and harden the Albuquerque lawyer? What made him so different from Walt, that their respective descents into large-scale criminality could warrant two very different fates for their protagonists? It boils down to a few factors.

Notably, The respective stories of Jimmy McGill becoming Saul Goodman and Walter White becoming Heisenberg are naturally similar in many ways, but one key difference is the way in which these stories ended, and thus, what Vince Gilligan and Peter Gould chose to say about the different kinds of men they were . While Walt, in his cruel and prideful downfall, was sentenced by the writers to both death and illegal infamy, Better Call Saul saw Jimmy turn down a cushy seven-year stint in a white-collar establishment due to a guilty conscience. It could be argued that Walt also experienced a guilty conscience in the finale of Breaking Bad , in his decisions to save Jesse ( Aaron Paul ) and, more effectively, admit to Skyler ( Anna Gunn ) that he did it all for himself, not the family. However, Walt had more to gain from this return to Albuquerque, specifically tying up all his loose ends, defeating his enemies, and ensuring his money would be given to his family. Jimmy's conscience, on the other hand, is personified purely by his beloved Kim Wexler ( Rhea Seehorn ).

title: BL Explainer: SEBI’s new Closing Auction Session, what investors need to know
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Beginning August 3, exchanges will move from the existing volume-weighted average price mechanism, based on the last 30 minutes of trading, to a Closing Auction Session, a 20-minute call auction designed to arrive at a single equilibrium closing price | Photo Credit: HEMANSHI KAMANI

Adding to this, India’s stock market is set for a significant change in how official closing prices are determined. Beginning August 3, exchanges will move from the existing volume-weighted average price (VWAP) mechanism, based on the last 30 minutes of trading, to a Closing Auction Session (CAS), a 20-minute call auction designed to arrive at a single equilibrium closing price. The move, introduced by SEBI and the exchanges, aims to strengthen price discovery, reduce the risk of end-of-day price manipulation, and ensure that benchmark prices used for indices, derivative settlements and mutual fund NAVs more accurately reflect true market demand and supply. Here’s what the new CAS means for investors, brokers and the broader market.
Meanwhile, How does the closing auction session work? How is it better than the VWAP-based closing price discovery method?

Notably, Today, the closing price is the volume-weighted average of trades in the last 30 minutes of the session. SEBI’s own analysis found that large institutional orders, index rebalancing trades and aggressive strategies can still meaningfully sway that average, which then feeds into index values, derivative settlements and mutual fund NAVs.

As per the latest buzz, From August 3, closing auction session replaces this with a 20-minute call auction held between 3:15 pm to 3:35 pm. In this session, the buy and sell orders will initially be pooled. Then the equilibrium price will be arrived at which will be the closing price. The equilibrium price is the one where maximum orders can be executed. That’s a structurally stronger design: a call auction that aggregates genuine demand and supply is far harder to influence with a handful of late orders than a trailing average of actual trades.

In further updates, “The Closing Auction Session is a structurally stronger framework because it aggregates all buy and sell interest and determines a single equilibrium price based on genuine demand and supply. That makes it significantly harder to influence the official closing price with a few late trades,” shared Sandeep Chordia, COO, Kotak Securities.

On top of that, “For investors tracking index funds, ETFs and mutual fund NAVs, the move should result in a more robust and tamper-resistant reference price. CAS will reduces the scope for ‘marking the close’ — where a trader nudges the last-30-minute average — which indirectly protects retail and passive investors from a mispriced settlement number. The one behavioural change investors should know: stop-loss and iceberg orders won’t work inside the auction window, so anyone used to placing those near 3:15 pm will need to adjust.

This is because in CAS , the exchange needs to see the full buy and sell interest to calculate the equilibrium price where the maximum volume can be matched, unlike iceberg order that hides large portion of the total order quantity from the market. Similarly stop-loss orders are conditional orders that become active only when a trigger price is reached, whereas in CAS the price changes are not continuous, evolving tick by tick.

title: Your Weekly Horoscope, August 2-8, 2026: Letting Things Be Easy
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Adding to this, The movements of this week bring a sort of ease. As Chiron begins its retrograde in Taurus and Venus enters her home sign of Libra against the backdrop of several retrogrades and the continuation of Lions Gate, our old stories unravel. Whatever shows up in their space, we are able to hold with ease and grace. There is a homecoming of sorts happening, and it is not without its surprises. Your weekly horoscope for August 2-8, 2026, explains how to prepare yourself.

Meanwhile, The week begins with Chiron stationing retrograde on August 3, 2026. This exploration shifts our awareness inward. It looks backward. It observes beneath the surface, turning us away from the mirror of the outside world and allowing us to see our patterns. It takes us on a journey through the underworld of the self.

Notably, In June, Chiron entered Taurus for the first time in more than 40 years. The cosmic body in retrograde under the influence of the earth sign reminds us of the medicine, beauty, wisdom, and gift within our bodies. Chiron retrograde in Taurus is an invitation to return to our own rhythm. One that moves undeterred by external pressure, expectations, narratives regarding productivity, and fears surrounding security. It is a space designed to recognize our innate value. It’s a space wanting to remind us that we belong to life. That our worthiness to enjoy this world is not something that we must prove. That we do not need to earn our right to exist.

As per the latest buzz, On August 6, 2026, Venus enters her home sign of Libra, where she will remain until September 10, 2026. A sign symbolized by the scales of balance, Libra reminds us that balance is not a permanent state. It is not final, fixed, or static. Rather, it is continual, dynamic, and adaptive. It is a moment-to-moment dance of equilibrium.

In further updates, The planet Venus is beauty. She is art, love, ease, grace, and harmony. As Venus enters the sign she rules, she wants us to find equilibrium with ease. She wants us to create harmonious connections and to experience what our work, health, emotions, homes, and relationships can be like when we attune to our innate rhythms.

On top of that, Let Venus in Libra be the medicine for imbalance. Let it tell you where you are overextending and where you might be withdrawing. What restores balance may be as simple as a conversation, compromise, moment of beauty, or shift in attention.

The days ahead help you meet the parts of yourself that believe you need to earn your place in the world. The voices that measure your value against productivity, usefulness, and possessions. As you reconnect with your intuition, you start to know when things in your life are out of balance and what will bring you back to equanimity. Your weekly horoscope explains how to create the necessary space.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Nushrratt Bharuccha and Pashmina Roshan join Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee, Elvish Yadav in Remo D’Souza’s untitled action film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The action entertainer marks the maiden production of Viccky Jain's newly launched banner VJ Frames and brings together several fresh on-screen pairings.

Adding to this, The movie, which is being co-produced by Neeraj Tiwari and Viccky Jain, is expected to have gone on floors on August 1. While the makers are yet to officially announce the complete cast, sources indicate that the project is envisioned as a high-octane commercial action entertainer and will feature multiple first-time collaborations.

Meanwhile, One of the biggest highlights of the project is the fresh casting combinations. Nushrratt Bharuccha and Pashmina Roshan will be sharing screen space for the first time, while both actresses will also be seen opposite Tiger Shroff for the very first time in their careers. The movie also marks the first collaboration between Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav, making it an unusual and intriguing mix of talent from different entertainment backgrounds.

Notably, The untitled venture is expected to blend stylised action with mainstream entertainment, a space that Remo D'Souza has explored in previous commercial films. Although plot details are being kept tightly under wraps, the project is already generating curiosity owing to its unconventional ensemble cast.

As per the latest buzz, The movie also holds significance for producer Viccky Jain, who is making his debut as a movie producer under his newly launched banner, VJ Frames. Known to television audiences through his appearance on Bigg Boss and as the husband of star Ankita Lokhande, Viccky of late revealed the launch of his production house, with the Remo D'Souza directorial becoming its maiden venture.

In further updates, For Tiger Shroff, the movie adds another action-packed project to his lineup, while Abhishek Banerjee continues to diversify his filmography with commercial entertainers alongside content-driven cinema. Meanwhile, Elvish Yadav's inclusion marks another significant step in his acting career, as he shares screen space with established Bollywood actors.

On top of that, With filming now underway and an ensemble featuring Tiger Shroff, Nushrratt Bharuccha, Pashmina Roshan, Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav, the untitled action entertainer is shaping up to be one of the notable projects currently in production. More details regarding the movie's title, storyline and rollout schedule are expected to be revealed by the makers in the coming months.

title: Kangana Ranaut namedrops Saba Azad in snide remark to Hrithik Roshan: 'You are committed, don't tease a woman'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has reacted to the latest remark made by star Hrithik Roshan over the widely shared social media trend 'We need to apologise to Hrithik Roshan'. This trend is a reference to the highly publicised legal dispute between Hrithik and Kangana in 2016.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut and Hrithik Roshan were earlier engaged in a public spat, which embroiled into legal and public dispute in 2016. Kangana reignites feud with Hrithik Kangana took to her Instagram Stories on Saturday evening and wrote, “Dear Hrithik I am happy that you have found your perfect match, Saba Azad and you both look great together. You are in a committed relationship and it doesn't suit you to tease a woman like this. Instead you should condemn all those who are harassing and bullying me using your name.”
Meanwhile, She added, “Stop adding fuel to fire and embarrassing your partner, hope better sense prevails and you stop making unreasonable comments (thumbs up emoticon).”

Notably, Her comments arrived after Hrithik responded to the widely shared trend targeting Kangana. A post was shared by influencer Freddy Birdy, and it drew a response from the Bollywood star. Freddy shared a note on Instagram stating, "The world owes an apology to Hrithik Roshan." In the comments section, Hrithik responded, “My friend, siding with 'A' just cause you don't like 'B' anymore is a small part of the larger systemic issue plaguing our society. I'll wait, for when the context to it is the right one, and motivated by facts. That would be fair. But then again, who cares anymore right?”

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Kangana has been making headlines with her comments on the student protests. She picked Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das and called him ‘totally useless and unemployed.’ In response, Saurav told her to ‘take a chill pill’ and even told Barkha Dutt on The Mojo Story, “My friends were texting me and asking, ‘Why is she after your life?’ One of them shared that I may look a little like a young Hrithik Roshan . This is what my friends told me. I was pleasantly surprised. Why should someone like her attack someone like me?”

In further updates, In 2016, Hrithik Roshan registered a case against Kangana involving an exchange of emails between the two. Hrithik filed a complaint alleging that someone impersonating him was emailing Kangana using a bogus email ID. Kangana then claimed that Hrithik provided her with the email ID, and they had been communicating through the same email ID until 2014. The emails were allegedly sent in 2013 and 2014.

On top of that, In 2016, Hrithik sent a legal notice to Kangana after she referred to him as a silly ex. He denied having any kind of relationship with her. The two actors had worked together in the films Kites (2010) and Krrish 3 (2013). He then claimed that Kangana had been sending him hundreds of absurd emails.

Hrithik made his relationship with Saba Azad public by sharing a picture with her on social media. They made their first public appearance together at Karan Johar 's 50th birthday celebrations. Since then, they have been quite vocal about their relationship and often shared pictures from their vacations together.

title: Hrithik Roshan reacts to 'Sorry, Hrithik' trend amid Kangana Ranaut row: 'I'll wait when the context is right'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Hrithik Roshan has reacted to the widely shared 'We need to apologise to Hrithik Roshan ' trend on social media as Kangana Ranaut continues to face backlash over her remarks on the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)-led student movement. The star-politician had referred to Gen Z protesters and young women as "Generation Gutter" after criticising the language used by some protesters.

Adding to this, Hrithik Roshan and Kangana Ranaut were engaged in a bitter legal and public dispute in 2016. Hrithik responds to widely shared trend targeting Kangana One such post was shared by influencer Freddy Birdy, and it drew a response from the Bollywood star. Freddy shared a note on Instagram stating, "The world owes an apology to Hrithik Roshan." In the comments section, Hrithik responded, "My friend, siding with 'A' just cause you don't like 'B' anymore is a small part of the larger systemic issue plaguing our society. I'll wait, for when the context to it is the right one, and motivated by facts. That would be fair. But then again, who cares anymore right?"
Meanwhile, The widely shared 'We need to apologise to Hrithik Roshan' trend is seen as a reference to the highly publicised legal dispute between Hrithik Roshan and Kangana Ranaut in 2016.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Freddy Birdy (@freddy_birdy)

As per the latest buzz, Apart from targeting the protesters, Kangana also questioned CJP leader Saurav Das' identity as a student, compared his achievements with her own career milestones, and called him "useless". This prompted Saurav to respond while also comparing himself to Hrithik Roshan . He told Barkha Dutt on The Mojo Story, “My friends were texting me and asking, ‘Why is she after your life?’ One of them shared that I may look a little like a young Hrithik Roshan. This is what my friends told me. I was pleasantly surprised. Why should someone like her attack someone like me?”
In further updates, Saurav's statement sparked the 'We need to apologise to Hrithik Roshan' trend on social media, with many referencing the legal dispute between the two actors in 2016.

On top of that, In early 2016, Kangana Ranaut referred to Hrithik Roshan as a "silly ex" during an interview, implying that they had shared a past romantic relationship during the filming of Krrish 3. Hrithik denied the claim and sent a legal notice to Kangana demanding a public apology, alleging that the statement had damaged his reputation. Kangana refused to apologise and instead issued a counter-notice.
In 2017, the cybercrime cell as per reports filed a closure (nil) report, stating that the investigation did not yield definitive evidence to support the allegations.

title: Amid Batwara 1947 promotions, Sunny Deol recalls how Dharmendra backed Ghayal after every producer rejected it
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sunny Deol has kicked off the promotions of his soon-to-release movie Batwara 1947 in Jaipur. The movie is directed by Rajkumar Santoshi , who also helmed Sunny's breakthrough movie Ghayal (1990). In his latest Instagram post, the star shared a heartfelt anecdote about how his father, veteran star Dharmendra, decided to back Ghayal in the very same city after no other producer was willing to finance the project.

Adding to this, Sunny Deol with dad Dharmendra How Dharmendra decided to back Ghayal On X, Sunny posted a video featuring Rajkumar Santoshi and wrote, "Some journeys come full circle in ways you can never plan. Years ago, I believed deeply in a script written by a young Rajkumar Santoshi. We tried taking it to producers, but no one was ready to back the movie. That was when I decided to take it to Papa. Papa was shooting for Batwara in 1988 in Jaipur & staying at Rambagh Palace. Raj gave him the complete narration of Ghayal,& the moment it ended, Papa shared yes."

Meanwhile, He added, "More than the movie, what stayed with me was how proud he was that I had recognised and stood by such a powerful story. That faith became Ghayal. And now, all these years later, I returned to Jaipur for the first promotions of Batwara 1947. Papa’s Batwara (1989). My #Batwara1947 (2026). The same city. A lifetime of memories. And a circle that feels beautifully complete. ❤️🙏"

Notably, In Batwara 1947, Sunny Deol plays a Muslim man who migrates to Pakistan during the Partition. However, he discovers a Hindu woman, played by Shabana Azmi, living upstairs in his home who refuses to leave. He takes it upon himself to protect her while also ensuring the safety of his own family amid the communal riots.

As per the latest buzz, The movie also marks the first on-screen collaboration between Sunny and his son, Karan Deol, who plays his son in the movie. The cast also includes Ali Fazal, Abhimanyu Singh, Khushi Hajare and Kanikka Kapur in pivotal roles.

In further updates, Batwara 1947 also marks Preity Zinta's return to acting after more than five years. The movie's music has been composed by AR Rahman, with lyrics by Javed Akhtar. It has also been cleared by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) without any cuts. The movie is bankrolled by Aamir Khan under the banner of Aamir Khan Productions.

title: Jugni singer files police complaint over Jacqueline Fernandez's wardrobe malfunction clip, alleges AI tampering
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Singer Sonu Thukral has filed a police complaint after his of late rolled out track Jugni, featuring star Jacqueline Fernandez , landed in row. A clip from the song has been circulating on social media, allegedly showing Jacqueline experiencing a wardrobe malfunction.

Adding to this, Jacqueline Fernandez in a still from Jugni track. Sonu Thukral files complaint Sonu, who has sung the track alongside B Praak , filed a police complaint on Friday over the matter, alleging that the widely shared clip was created using artificial intelligence. He posted on Instagram to share a picture of himself with a police officer while holding a copy of the complaint. He wrote in the caption, "I have filed a police complaint regarding my song 'Jugni'. The clip has also been edited using AI, and the AI-generated version of the clip is being circulated further. I will talk about it publicly soon."
Meanwhile, Jacqueline Fernandez and the other members associated with the song have not yet issued an official statement on the matter.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sonu Thukral (@sonuthukral)

As per the latest buzz, Followers reacted strongly to the row. One comment read, "The seriousness of Sonu Thukral's allegations should be thoroughly investigated, and if the allegations are found to be true, the person who made the AI-edited video should be caught as soon as possible." Another user wrote, "15 days ago, Sonu Thukral's music video Jugni was rolled out, in which objectionable scenes of Jacqueline were shown. There was opposition to it on social media; people shared good and bad things, but now the truth has come to light. Sonu Thukral has opened up that those scenes were created by someone using AI, for which he has filed a report in cyber crime."

In further updates, On the work front, Jacqueline was last seen on the big screen in Welcome To The Jungle. The multi-starrer was led by Akshay Kumar and also featured Suniel Shetty, Disha Patani, Arshad Warsi, Jackie Shroff, Paresh Rawal, Raveena Tandon, Lara Dutta, Johny Lever, Shreyas Talpade, Tusshar Kapoor, Rajpal Yadav, Krushna Abhishek, Kiku Sharda, Daler Mehndi, Aftab Shivdasani and several others. Despite receiving mixed reviews, the movie performed decently at the ticket-window, earning ₹ 133.98 crore rupees net in India and grossing ₹ 192.60 crore rupees worldwide.

On top of that, Jacqueline currently has one movie in the pipeline. She is as per reports set to star in a supernatural thriller produced by Khyati Madaan's Not Out Entertainment. As per the latest buzz, the movie went on floors earlier this year. However, it has not yet been officially revealed.

title: Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee, and Elvish Yadav team up for Remo D'Souza's action franchise as Viccky Jain launches VJ Frames
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The producer-entrepreneur revealed his new production banner on his birthday, with its maiden venture set to be a high-octane entertainer directed by Remo D'Souza.

Adding to this, The newly launched banner aims to back commercial entertainers across genres, with its debut project expected to combine action, spectacle and mainstream storytelling. While the makers have kept plot details under wraps, the announcement has already generated curiosity owing to the unusual casting combination of Tiger Shroff, known for his action-packed performances, alongside versatile star Abhishek Banerjee and content creator-turned-star Elvish Yadav.

Meanwhile, Speaking about the launch of VJ Frames, Viccky Jain described the occasion as the fulfilment of a long-cherished ambition. He shared, "Launching VJ Frames is a dream that has been years in the making, and I couldn't have asked for a better occasion than my birthday to begin this journey. Cinema has always inspired me, and with VJ Frames, I hope to create stories that entertain, connect with audiences, and leave a lasting impact. Beginning this journey with an ambitious action franchise alongside Remo and an incredible cast makes it even more special. This is just the beginning, and I'm excited for everything that lies ahead."

Notably, Director Remo D'Souza also expressed his enthusiasm about collaborating with the newly launched banner and shared his confidence in the project saying, "I'm really happy to be directing the first movie from VJ Frames. Viccky has come on board with a clear vision and a genuine passion for cinema, and it's exciting to be part of this journey with him. We've got a fantastic cast in Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav, and I'm looking forward to creating something that's entertaining, action-packed and enjoyable for audiences."

As per the latest buzz, Although further details regarding the movie's title, storyline, rollout schedule and the remaining cast are yet to be revealed, the project marks a notable collaboration between Remo D'Souza and Tiger Shroff, both of whom are known for their expertise in action and dance-driven entertainers.

In further updates, With the launch of VJ Frames, Viccky Jain enters movie production with plans to develop a diverse slate of projects in the coming years. The Remo D'Souza directorial is expected to be the first of several films under the banner, setting the tone for its vision of delivering large-scale commercial cinema to audiences across the country.

Adding to this, On that note, if you’re wondering whether your Galaxy device is eligible for One UI 9, what new features it brings, or how to download and install the update, this roundup has you covered.

Subsequently, Samsung has implemented various core Android 17 and Android features in general into One UI 9, such as flexible multitasking and a Pixel-style Google search bar below the dock on the homescreen, as well as several under-the-hood security and privacy measures.

title: Vijay Varma recalls casting couch experience during his days of struggle: ‘He got a little touchy-feely’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

From Gully Boy and Dahaad to Darlings, Vijay Varma has built a reputation for delivering powerful performances, one project after another. However, the star's journey to success in the Hindi movie industry was far from easy. In a recent interaction, Vijay opened up about experiencing the casting couch when he briefly tried his hand at modelling during the early days of his struggle.

Adding to this, Vijay Varma opens up on facing casting couch. (Photo: Instagram) 'He started to misbehave with me' In conversation with Prakhar Gupta on his YouTube channel, Vijay recalled the time he was made to feel uncomfortable by a modelling coordinator. He shared, “I tried modelling in Hyderabad, just small-time, amateur-level work. But I came across this weird model coordinator. He started to misbehave with me a little bit, like just trying to get a little touchy-feely. I shared, ‘Bro, what is this? What are you doing?’ So I got discouraged immediately. You get discouraged very quickly when you’re still inexperienced. Then I thought, I think I should address it head-on. If acting is what I want to do, then I have to do it.”

Meanwhile, Discouraged by his first experience in the modelling industry, Vijay decided to pursue acting. However, the road remained challenging, as he was initially rejected by a theatre school in Hyderabad. He shared, “So I went to a theatre school in Hyderabad called Sutradhar School of Acting. I told them, ‘I want to learn acting.’ But they turned me away. They shared, ‘It requires commitment, it requires dedication. This isn’t something you’ll do for two days and then leave.’ I thought, they’re not even giving me a chance.”

Notably, Vijay then applied to the prestigious Movie and Television Institute of India (FTII), but faced rejection there as well. It was only on his second attempt that he secured admission to the institute, where he went on to study acting alongside actors such as Rajkummar Rao and Jaideep Ahlawat.

As per the latest buzz, On the work front, Vijay Varma was last seen in Vibhu Puri's directorial Gustaakh Ishq. The movie also starred Naseeruddin Shah , Fatima Sana Shaikh and Sharib Hashmi, and marked fashion designer Manish Malhotra's debut as a movie producer.

In further updates, Most of late, Vijay was seen in the web series Matka King, which traces the transformation of a humble and enterprising cotton trader into a powerful gambling don as he creates a new gambling game called Matka.

title: How Priyanka Chopra's Mary Kom biopic inspired Pakistan's 1st female CWG boxing medallist Fatima Zahra to pick up sport
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

India's MC Mary Kom has inspired generations of homegrown boxers, but the six-time world champion's influence has travelled well beyond the country's borders, reaching Pakistan's first female Commonwealth Games medallist, Fatima Zahra. It was after watching the movie based on Mary Kom's life, which starred Priyanka Chopra , that a 10-year-old Fatima decided to become a boxer.

Adding to this, Pakistant's first female boxer to win a CWG medal used to train while watching Priyanka Chopra's Mary Kom biopic. How Priyanka Chopra's Mary Kom inspired Fatima This week, the 22-year-old signed off with a historic bronze medal in the women's 60kg event at the Glasgow Games. This is the first medal in boxing at the Commonwealth Games by a Pakistani woman.
Meanwhile, Growing up in Sargodha in Pakistan's Punjab province, Fatima had few female boxing role models to look up to in her own country. She instead found one across the border in Mary Kom.

Notably, “I am inspired by India's Mary Kom,” Fatima told PTI after securing her bronze medal. For Fatima, it was not just Mary Kom's achievements but the story behind them that resonated. The 2014 Bollywood biopic based on Mary Kom's life left a lasting impression on a then-10-year-old Fatima.

As per the latest buzz, “I used to watch the movie made on her life. When I started boxing, I used to watch that movie and train. I have a lot of respect for her, and inshallah, one day I will become like her. I hope I can meet her,” Fatima shared.

In further updates, Directed by Omung Kumar, Mary Kom starred Priyanka Chopra as the six-time world champion and Olympic medallist boxer. The movie won a National Movie Award for Best Popular Movie Providing Wholesome Entertainment and was a commercial success, earning ₹ 86 crore rupees at the ticket-window.

On top of that, Born into a poor farming family in rural Manipur, Mary Kom overcame financial hardship, social resistance and limited resources to become one of the greatest boxers of all time. She secretly pursued boxing in her early years, balancing training with work in the fields.

Like Mary Kom, Fatima also had to battle opposition at home before she could chase her dreams. “My background is not that strong. My basic coach taught me everything. My family was against boxing. They would not let me go for training, but I fought with them and continued training,” she shared.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra review
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold just went Ultra. With the new addition of the wider and shorter Galaxy Z Fold8 this year, the Z Fold7's successor takes on the Ultra role in the lineup. But is the upgrade limited to the name alone?

Adding to this, The Galaxy Z Fold7 was the first foldable from Samsung that brought significant hardware upgrades in a while, and while the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra doesn't bring nearly as dramatic changes on the outside it still adds a bunch of new stuff inside.

Meanwhile, Starting with the expected chip upgrade to Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 (for Galaxy), the new Fold8 Ultra also gains an improved display tech with a less noticeable crease, higher resolution and anti-reflective coating and a better ultrawide camera that brings it closer to the Galaxy S26 Ultra's camera setup. There is also a significantly bigger battery as well as faster wired and wireless charging.
Notably, Additionally, Samsung used tougher materials for the frame, without increasing the weight or size of the handset, so it remains just as thin and lightweight as its predecessor.

As per the latest buzz, We are pretty sure the battery and the charging will make a big impact on user experience. The older Folds were stuck at 25W wired charging for far too long, so upping the charging power to 45W is more than welcome. The increase in battery capacity by about 14% (from 4,400 to 5,000 mAh) should put the Z Fold8 Ultra back in the race when it comes to foldables' battery life, too. And Samsung finally embraces the silicon-carbon battery packs, enabling it to improve density and thus save weight.

In further updates, Some software improvements are also in place - the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra brings some cool new Gemini AI smarts and launches with the latest Android 17 with One UI 9 on top. Yes, that means the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Flip8 lineups are the first handsets running Google's latest Android 17 out of the box.
On top of that, Without further ado, let's see if Samsung still has what it takes to keep up with the growing foldable market.
The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra's retail package is business as usual - nothing interesting besides the quick start guides and a USB-C to USB-C cable used for charging and data transfer.

title: This TV star left acting for farming at his peak, but lost everything, faced abuse from recovery agents; now he...
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Rajesh Kumar , best known for playing Rosesh Sarabhai in the beloved early-2000s sitcom Sarabhai vs Sarabhai , of late opened up about the financial hardships he faced after quitting acting to pursue farming full-time. The star opened up that he had to sell his car and even endure abuse from credit card recovery agents after being unable to repay his debts.

Adding to this, Rajesh Kumar spoke about losing everythig after quitting acting. 'Turned to farming and lost everything' In conversation with SCREEN about that phase of his life, Rajesh reflected on how his decision to leave acting and take up farming cost him his financial security at the age of 42. He shared, “I think it was all part of God’s plan. What happened was that, at what many would call the peak of my career, I took a sabbatical from acting at the age of 42. I turned to farming, and I lost everything. Then I returned to acting in 2022. Those five years transformed me as a human being. I became more real, more grounded. I mean I came to understand the depths of suffering, how much pain a person can endure, how humiliating it feels when you have nothing left.”

Meanwhile, Rajesh admitted that he hit rock bottom when he had to sell his car and deal with abuse from credit card recovery agents. However, he shared he never allowed himself to fall into depression despite the difficult circumstances. Recalling those challenging years, he shared, “I’ve lived through moments where the credit card recovery agent would call the watchman’s cabin downstairs and abuse me because I didn’t have the money to pay. I sold my car. The last vehicle I owned was an Eco Car, which I eventually handed over to my farmers in Nashik because I couldn’t pay them. I’ve been through so much. But despite all that, I never allowed myself to sink into depression, anxiety, or any kind of negative emotion. The biggest takeaway from the last four or five years has been the learning; it has been incredibly beautiful.”

Notably, Rajesh is best known for playing the iconic character of Rosesh Sarabhai in Sarabhai vs Sarabhai. In recent years, however, the star has consciously taken up diverse projects to move beyond that image.

As per the latest buzz, His web series Yeh Meri Family received widespread appreciation from audiences. He has also appeared in acclaimed web shows such as Rana Naidu and Freedom at Midnight. Apart from web series, Rajesh has played supporting roles in films including Saiyaara, Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, Nishaanchi, and several others.

title: ASK IRA: Was now-retired Josh Richardson the Heat’s best-ever second-round value?
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:
Q: Josh Richardson was a good guy and a good Heat story when he arrived, wish him nothing but the best in his retirement. – Doug.

Adding to this, A: He was and he was. Remember, in that 2015 draft, Josh Richardson, who revealed his retirement this week , went No. 40 in the second round to the Heat, with Justise Winslow going No. 10 to the Heat in that draft’s first round. There is no question that Josh had the better career, with Justise’s lack of an outside shot ultimately ending his NBA tenure not by his own doing. Josh long has had interests outside of the game with his music background and simply was able to decide to step away on his own terms. When it comes to Heat value picks in the second round, Josh, at No. 40 in 2015, is right up there with Grant Long at No. 33 in 1988, Sherman Douglas at No. 28 in 1989, Matt Geiger at No. 42 in 1992, Rasual Butler at No. 53 in 2002, Mario Chalmers at No. 34 in 2008, Patrick Beverley at No. 42 in 2009 and Pelle Larsson at No. 44 in 2024.
Meanwhile, Q: Ira when should we expect the next batch of signings? – Bruce.

Notably, A: It’s all a game of dominos and could come down to the buyout market, as teams wait for the likes of Klay Thompson , D’Angelo Russell and, possibly, Zach LaVine to potentially hit the buyout market. I’m not sure there is any player the Heat would consider “got away” if they sign elsewhere. For now, the Heat are positioned to be able to sign any player to the minimum while still having the maximum share of their exception money (about $7 million) to utilize in a trade or on the buyout market.
As per the latest buzz, Q: Who do you expect to be opening night starters? – Miles.

In further updates, A: Don’t know, since the fifth starter might not currently be on the roster. For now, you can circle Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo, Andrew Wiggins and Davion Mitchell for four of the spots, with the fifth likely a choice, at the moment, between Tim Hardaway Jr. and Pelle Larsson. But keep in mind that DeMar DeRozan has started 1,252 of his 1,264 career regular-season appearances, last playing off the bench during his 2009-10 rookie season.

title: T-Series honours Neeraj Kalyan for 30 years of leadership; Bhushan Kumar calls him a pillar of strength
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Having joined the company during a period when the Indian music industry was on the cusp of transformation, Kalyan has been instrumental in steering T-Series through some of its biggest transitions. From the era of physical music formats to the rise of digital streaming, and from domestic success to establishing a formidable global footprint, his strategic vision has helped the company remain ahead of the curve in an ever-evolving entertainment landscape.

Adding to this, Over the years, Kalyan has overseen key areas including music publishing, digital licensing, strategic partnerships and legal affairs, while also helping drive the company's commercial expansion. His leadership has been central to T-Series' emergence as one of the world's leading music labels and a dominant force in Indian cinema.

Meanwhile, Paying tribute to Kalyan's three-decade-long journey, T-Series Chairman and Managing Director Bhushan Kumar acknowledged the executive's invaluable contribution to the organisation's success.

Notably, "A true leader doesn't just navigate the future; they create it. Neeraj has been a pillar of strength, a trusted teammate, and a beacon of inspiration for everyone at T-Series over the past three decades. His passion, vision, and unparalleled contributions have been instrumental in transforming T-Series into a global music and movie powerhouse. I extend my heartfelt appreciation for his unwavering commitment to our family, and we look forward to honoring his legacy and achieving many more milestones together," shared Bhushan Kumar.

As per the latest buzz, Kalyan's tenure has coincided with some of the most transformative phases in the music business, including the rapid adoption of digital platforms and the growing importance of global licensing and strategic collaborations. His ability to anticipate industry shifts and build long-term partnerships has ensured that T-Series continues to strengthen its leadership position not only in India but across international markets.

In further updates, The celebration serves as both a recognition of Kalyan's remarkable journey and a testament to the role he has played in building T-Series into the global entertainment powerhouse it is today. As the company continues to expand its footprint across music, films and digital content, Kalyan remains one of the key architects behind its sustained growth and long-term vision.

title: ‘Wanted performers over so-called stars’: Dhurandhar producer reveals why Ranveer Singh was cast in the film
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Dhurandhar, starring Ranveer Singh in the lead role, shattered records upon rollout last year and became a massive smash hit. Directed by Aditya Dhar , it featured Ranveer as an Indian spy on a mission in Pakistan. The movie grossed over ₹ 1300 crore rupees globally. In a new interview with Outlook Business, Dhurandhar's co-producer and Jio Studios CEO Jyoti Deshpande reflected on the journey of making the project and shared why Ranveer was cast in the lead.

Adding to this, Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar was rolled out in theatres on December 5, 2025. (Netflix) What Jyoti shared Talking about mounting the movie with a big budget, Jyoti shared, “Dhurandhar is a project that overran multiple times, and I indulged it every time. I reinvented it. You know, somehow one part became two parts, but we found a way… there was mad conviction. Everyone was involved. Aditya Dhar, to begin with. And Ranveer Singh, the star, who went all in and did nothing else for the duration of the movie. Every technician who was part of that movie, whether it’s cinematography, sound design, editing, everyone was all in. We all knew we were making something that had so much purpose, so much heart, that had never been seen before, that had never been done before. And it was almost like, if we don’t do this, we’re not alive. I mean, we have to do this against all odds. So it defied everything. I had to keep finding a way to move forward and not stop.”

Meanwhile, Speaking about the casting of Ranveer, she went on to say, “There were no safe things we could do because it was already an expensive movie to shoot. Now, if we added expensive actors as well, it was going to render the movie unviable on day one. So we wanted performers rather than the so-called stars… I had worked with Ranveer on Ram-Leela and Bajirao Mastani , when he wasn’t this big. So I had worked with him when he was starting out, and I still believe those are some of my favourite films of Ranveer Singh. I find him an absolutely outstanding star who gives it all. He transforms into a character. I love that about him, the fact that he is not Ranveer Singh in that movie. When he has to become Bajirao, he becomes Bajirao. When he has to become Khilji, he becomes Khilji. When he has to become the Gully Boy, he becomes the Gully Boy. So he transforms; he doesn’t play Ranveer Singh.”

Notably, Dhurandhar tells the story of Jaskirat Singh Rangi, alias Hamza Ali Mazari , sent to Lyari in Pakistan to bring down a terror unit. He infiltrates a Baloch gang, marries the daughter of a Lyari politician and integrates into the society there to do this.

As per the latest buzz, The first movie was rolled out in theatres on December 5, 2025, and Dhurandhar 2 on March 19 this year. Ranveer, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, R Madhavan, Sara Arjun, Rakesh Bedi, Gaurav Gera, and Danish Pandor star in the two films. The first movie collected ₹ 1307 crore rupees worldwide, while the sequel grossed ₹ 1790 crore rupees.

title: Salman Khan celebrates ‘bada bhai’ Sanjay Dutt with a tight hug, has an emotional reunion
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood stars Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt have been friends for decades. On July 29, Sanjay celebrated his 67th birthday. Now Salman has shared a pair of pictures on his social media where he celebrated his longtime friend and their bond in a heartfelt post.

Adding to this, Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt's friendship is still as strong as ever. Salman's post for Sanjay In the pictures, Salman and Sanjay gave each other a tight hug. Sharing the pictures, Salman wrote, “Babaaaa for ever baba aur baba, baba hota hai. Sanju baba hai hum sab ka baba n Sanju baba now apne bacchon ka baba, mera bada bhai Sanjay Dutt, Allah, Bhagwan Jesus sab iss Aadhmi ko khush rakhain, I love you Baba (Baba forever. A baba is always a baba. Sanju Baba belongs to all of us, and now he is a father to his own children too. My elder brother Sanjay Dutt. May Allah, Bhagwan and Jesus always keep this man happy. I love you, Baba)." In the pictures, Salman was seen in a T-shirt and jeans, with a cap covering his new hairdo.

Meanwhile, Sanjay and Salman have worked together in several films like Dus, Saajan, Chal Mere Bhai and more. At a pre-rollout event for Sikandar, Salman had even revealed a movie with Sanjay, revealing it would be an action movie. Further details are still awaited. Last year in July, Sanjay was in a chat with Curly Tales when he had opened up about his fondness for Salman. Sanjay shared, “I think it’s from the time of Saajan. Salman is a lovely person, he’s like a younger brother to me. I can’t detach from him—he is my brother.”

Notably, On the small screen, they hosted the fifth season of Bigg Boss together. Salman and Sanjay were also seen together in 2012 in a special song titled, Po Po, in Son Of Sardaar, which also featured Ajay Devgn and Sonakshi Sinha. They were of late seen in special appearances in the Saudi action movie 7 Dogs.

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Salman of late grabbed headlines for his comments on the student protests and Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike . Speaking about the student protest, he admitted that he is glad to know that the kids of the country have come together for a better educational system. He also appealed to activist Sonam Wangchuk, urging him to end his hunger strike at the CJP protest. His message, “Sonam, it’s done bro. Don’t extend this,” sparked a meme fest on social media.

He also appealed to activist Sonam Wangchuk, urging him to end his hunger strike at the CJP protest. His message, “Sonam, it’s done bro. Don’t extend this,” sparked a meme fest on social media.

In further updates, Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and movie festivals. He has a keen interest in writing about South Asian independent films and has covered several movie festivals, including Sundance and CPH: Docx. He also brings a sharp perspective to the monthly column called The Fault in Our Stars, where he writes about a recent movie/series and what stops the ‘good’ from becoming ‘great’. A gold medalist from Banaras Hindu University, Santanu completed his postgraduate studies in English from Jadavpur University. He is also a Rotten Tomatoes-certified movie critic. When not watching films or in conversation with celebrities, Santanu can be found reading a book. Some of his favourite films are Aparajito, Ponyo and The Double Life of Veronique. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own. Santanu continues to write passionately about films and star culture.
